title: Study-abroad / gap-year program research
description: Research a candidate study-abroad or gap-year program's academics and credit transfer alongside its safety and cost profile, then score readiness for a parent decision.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: study-abroad-research
  title: Study-abroad / gap-year program research
  description: Research a candidate study-abroad or gap-year program's academics and credit transfer alongside its safety and cost profile, then score readiness for a parent decision.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a scored, parent-approved readiness summary for a candidate study-abroad or gap-year program.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 2
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor: [parent-approval]
  nodes:
    - id: program-candidate-brief
      kind: input
      name: Study-abroad or gap-year program brief
      summary: The candidate program, student goals, and budget.
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: "The candidate study-abroad or gap-year program, student goals, and budget." }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: program-credit-researcher
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Program and academic-credit researcher
      summary: Researches the curriculum and credit-transfer policy.
      role: Study-abroad academic and credit-transfer researcher
      prompt: Research the program's academic curriculum, credit-transfer policy, and how it aligns with the student's degree requirements. Describe which official program and home-institution registrar pages to check rather than asserting unverified transfer-credit specifics. This is informational research only, and the family should confirm actual credit transfer with the student's registrar.
      capabilities: { skills: [research], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: safety-cost-researcher
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Safety and cost researcher
      summary: Researches destination safety considerations and program cost and logistics.
      role: Travel safety and program cost researcher
      prompt: Research the destination's general safety considerations using official travel-advisory sources, and the program's published cost, insurance, and logistics details. Describe what travel-advisory and program-disclosure pages to check rather than inventing specific prices or safety ratings. This is not professional safety or financial advice, and the family should confirm current advisories and costs with official sources before committing.
      capabilities: { skills: [risk-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: parallel-research-group
      kind: group
      name: Parallel program and safety research
      summary: Runs the academic-credit and safety/cost research side by side.
      config: { members: [program-credit-researcher, safety-cost-researcher], execution: parallel, exit: aggregate }
    - id: score-program-readiness
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score program readiness
      summary: Scores the combined academic and safety/cost findings for decision readiness.
      role: Independent program-readiness evaluator
      prompt: Using the combined academic and safety-or-cost findings, return a score, pass/fail, and reasons on whether the program looks ready for family decision-making. This is advisory research support only, not a guarantee of safety, cost, or credit transfer, and the family should verify current details with official sources before committing.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.75 }
    - id: parent-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Parent sign-off on program
      summary: Pause for the parent to review the readiness summary and decide.
    - id: study-abroad-output
      kind: output
      name: Study-abroad program decision summary
      summary: The final readiness summary and the parent's decision.
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: program-candidate-brief, to: parallel-research-group, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: parallel-research-group, to: score-program-readiness, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: score-program-readiness, to: parent-approval, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: parent-approval, to: study-abroad-output, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
